author: Karl Rock
description:
One thing really surprised me while travelling around Pakistan. Almost every taxi driver reminded me to put my seatbelt on.

The reason? The fine for not wearing one is 10,000 PKR (around US$36), which is a significant amount of money for many people. It's a simple rule that's taken seriously, and honestly, I wish more countries did the same.

Have you ever been somewhere that completely changed your expectations? Let me know in the comments!
title: This Shocked Me in Pakistan
